    // 02 / THE PLAYING FIELD

    Game index.

    26 of 45 environment cards now contain a validated task, covering 33 runnable scenarios. The remaining 19 include an experimental racing adapter and planned indie and AAA integrations. Library cards cover only the tasks named in their details. Every validated card includes a screenshot and a short clip from recorded evaluation frames. Candidate cards use credited project previews and link to project media; those previews are not benchmark results. Clips play only when selected.

    01 / MEASURE

    The whole response path.

    Snapshot retrieval, image encoding, transport, inference and validation. Engine updates between decisions are outside the clock; these are lockstep tasks, not continuous real-time gameplay.

    02 / COMPARE

    The same playing field.

    Fixed scenarios, identical seed sets, equal game weights and visible uncertainty. Exhibition and realtime runs stay separate.

    03 / VERIFY

    Replay the evidence.

    Referee scores, fresh observation challenges, frame hashes and replayable action traces. No self-reported rewards.

    // 03 / ENTER YOUR AGENT

    One protocol.
    Any policy.

    Read an image. Choose an allowed action. Run the suite.
    No model SDK is required for a local submission.

    Submit an evaluationRead the protocol
    QUICK START 
    git clone https://github.com/DanielTea/generalgamebench
cd generalgamebench
uv sync --extra doom
uv run generalgamebench run --agent react \
  --games coin-run dodge-lanes doom-basic \
  --seeds 10 --output runs/my-agent

    Bring your own policy with --agent-command.
    Submissions go through evidence review; uploads never auto-rank.
